subject: Request: temporary priority response window amendment for AlphaTech migration
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@alphatech.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: platform@alphatech.com
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary priority response window amendment for AlphaTech migration

Hi Marcus,

We're planning a region migration for AlphaTech's payments platform on Apr 5-7 (UTC 00:00-08:00 each day). Historically those windows generate a higher volume of P2 incidents and our team will be stretched across the migration.

Would Redwood consider a temporary amendment to our response windows for that maintenance window? Specifically we are requesting:
- For Apr 5 00:00 UTC through Apr 7 08:00 UTC: P1 target remains 15m; P2 target shortened to 60m (from our standard 4h)
- A named escalation contact and a dedicated Slack channel during the window

We understand this is out of policy — happy to accept a one-time operational surcharge or scope-limited contract amendment. Attached is our migration runbook and projected incident curve.

Can you confirm feasibility and next steps? We need a signed amendment by Apr 1 to lock in the runbook.

Thanks,

Samira Khan
Head of Platform
AlphaTech
[Attachment: alpha_surge_plan.xlsx (XLSX)]

Quick asks:
- Ben: can ops staff an additional overlap for those UTC windows? If yes, provide an approximate cost/surcharge and any headcount impact.
- Irene: can we designate a named escalation SRE and confirm on-call overlap? Also note any runbook requirements.
- Laura: can legal draft a short amendment (term + surcharge + liability language) and confirm DocuSign turnaround?

I've attached AlphaTech's runbook. Please reply with option(s) and a recommended draft we'll send back to them.

Thanks — Marcus

TL;DR: We can provide a temporary 'surge SLO' for Apr 5-7 with an operational surcharge. Two feasible options:

Option A (recommended): Dedicated surge coverage + reduced P2 to 60m during requested windows. Requires 2x additional on-call seats staggered across the three-night window. One-time surcharge: $18,000 (covers extended coverage + standby engineering). We estimate ~24 hours of engineering support/day across the windows.

Option B: Standard SLA unchanged, but we provide a 24/7 escalation hotline + engineering hotseat during migration start/critical flips. No surcharge but customer takes higher risk for P2.

Attachments: ops_capacity_brief.pdf with shift plan and headcount model. Irene — need your sign-off on named escalation contact and whether we can guarantee 60m for P2 under our current pager coverage.

Ben

We can accommodate a temporary 'surge SLO' for Apr 5 00:00 UTC through Apr 7 08:00 UTC with the following terms (compromise to balance risk/capacity):

- P1: 15 minutes (unchanged)
- P2: 60 minutes target during the defined windows only
- Dedicated escalation: named Redwood SRE (Irene Choi) + dedicated Slack channel; engineering hotseat during the three nights
- One-time operational surcharge: $15,000 (discounted from ops quote after scope alignment)

Next steps:
1) Laura will send a short amendment via DocuSign. Please review and sign by Apr 1 to confirm.
2) Ben will provision the shifts and confirmation of the hotseat calendar; you'll receive calendar invites and the Slack channel link.
3) We will run a quick pre-migration sync on Apr 3 to align on runbook triggers.

Attached is the draft amendment (slo_amendment_draft.pdf). If this works, we'll route to DocuSign immediately.

Thanks — Marcus
